note: Indexed on Matthew's own structure — the five discourses and the narrative blocks between them — beginning with the first discourse. Practice tags are assigned from the definitions in WMT A1, not from practice names.
synoptic_note: Entries carry an optional synoptic_parallel field recording the corresponding passage in Luke. It is a plain cross-reference: the same material appears in both Gospels, and a reader working through one may want the other. Pericope boundaries follow Matthew's own arrangement, so a parallel sometimes covers only part of an entry. All scripture is WEB, per the standing rule in WMT G10.

entries.pericope: Tamar, Rahab, Ruth, and the wife of Uriah
entries.connection: Four women are named in a patrilineal genealogy, and each is attached to an irregularity the list makes no attempt to smooth over. The line is presented complete with what would ordinarily be edited out of it.

entries.pericope: Not willing to make her a public example
entries.connection: Joseph is called righteous in the same sentence that says he intended to divorce her quietly. Covering Weakness enacted at real cost to himself and before he has any reason to think she is innocent — the protection is extended on the assumption of guilt.

entries.pericope: Rachel weeping for her children
entries.connection: The escape into Egypt is placed beside the killing of the children who did not escape, and Jeremiah's line is quoted rather than resolved — she refused to be comforted, because they are no more. The Gospel records a deliverance and the grief it did not prevent, side by side.

entries.pericope: Bring forth fruit worthy of repentance
entries.connection: Descent from Abraham is dismissed as evidence, and the demand is for fruit rather than lineage or ceremony. C12's proof test stated at the entry point of the Gospel, before anything else is asked.

entries.pericope: Man shall not live by bread alone
entries.connection: Three proposals, each answered from what he already carried rather than from argument, and each refused at the moment it is made. Watchfulness at the gate — nothing is weighed on its merits before being turned away.

entries.pericope: The Beatitudes
entries.connection: The road's destination described as a set of conditions rather than achievements — poor in spirit, mourning, gentle, hungry, merciful, pure, peacemaking. Mercy is the only one whose reward is itself in kind, which is the reciprocity C03 builds its blueprint on.

entries.pericope: Salt and light; a city on a hill
entries.connection: Visibility is stated as a fact about the thing rather than as an ambition — a city on a hill cannot be hidden. The Citizen-Stranger given its outward face: full presence in the world, with the good works seen and the glory redirected.

entries.pericope: Not to destroy the law but to fulfill
entries.connection: Continuity with the older moral order asserted before any of it is intensified. The whole Sermon depends on this: what follows raises the standard rather than replacing it, which is the structural claim C01 makes about the moral order being a structure and not a menu.

entries.pericope: Anger, and leaving the gift at the altar
entries.connection: The prohibition is moved upstream from the act to the anger, and then reconciliation is ranked above worship — leave the gift, go, and come back. The movement is required of the one who remembers his brother has something against him, regardless of who is at fault, which is Self-Accusation stated as a liturgical interruption.
entries.review: PR03 added on synthesis review — 5:23-24 puts the initiative on the one who remembers, not the one who was wronged.

entries.pericope: The lustful gaze; the eye and the hand
entries.connection: The offense relocated to the interior movement that precedes it, which is the definition of nepsis rather than an intensification of the rule. The severity of the remedy measures how early the watchman is meant to be posted.

entries.pericope: Divorce
entries.connection: A concession in the older law is narrowed rather than expanded, and the consequence is stated in terms of what it does to the other person. Household fidelity treated as an obligation with a victim, not as a private arrangement.

entries.pericope: Do not swear at all; let your Yes be Yes
entries.connection: Oaths abolished on the grounds that reliable speech makes them unnecessary. The same instruction James 5:12 carries and the Didache sets against the double tongue — speech that needs no reinforcement because it is already true.

entries.pericope: Turn the other cheek; go the second mile
entries.connection: Retaliation is not merely forbidden but replaced by a surplus — the other cheek, the cloak as well, the second mile. Non-Retaliation and Absorbing the Blow given their governing text, and the Didache's opening chapter draws directly on it.

entries.pericope: Love your enemies; he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good
entries.connection: The circle of concern widened to its limit and then grounded in how sun and rain are distributed. Shedding Harshness given its summit text: loving those who love you is named as the ordinary human floor, not the standard.

entries.pericope: Let your merciful deeds be in secret
entries.connection: Almsgiving commanded and then stripped of its audience — the left hand kept ignorant of the right. Habitual Almsgiving and the Hidden Life joined in one instruction, which is why generosity here cannot double as reputation.

entries.pericope: The inner room, and the Lord's Prayer
entries.connection: The Secret Place given as a physical instruction — a room, a shut door — followed by the prayer the Didache directs be said three times daily. The Daily Anchors and the Secret Rhythmic Devotion both take their text from here, and the forgiveness clause is the only petition Jesus returns to afterward.

entries.pericope: When you fast, anoint your head
entries.connection: Discipline required to be concealed rather than displayed, with the concealment made active — wash, anoint, look ordinary. The Hidden Life stated as method: the practice is kept, and the appearance of keeping it is deliberately removed.

entries.pericope: Treasure, the sound eye, and two masters
entries.connection: Three images for a single claim: what you hold determines what you see and whom you serve. The heart is said to follow the treasure rather than direct it, which is why C07 treats cleansed sight as a matter of attachment before it is a matter of judgment.

entries.pericope: The birds, the lilies, and tomorrow's anxiety
entries.connection: Anxiety answered by observation rather than argument — look at the birds, consider the lilies. The Discipline of Unknowing applied to the future, and the closing instruction limits the day's burden to the day itself.

entries.pericope: The speck and the beam
entries.connection: Correction of another is made conditional on prior self-examination, and the disproportion is comic on purpose. The Moral Audit and Self-Accusation given their common text — the sequence is not optional, and sight of the other's fault is said to depend on it.

entries.pericope: Pearls before pigs
entries.connection: A restraint on giving what is true to those who will trample it, placed immediately after the prohibition on judging. The same triage Proverbs 9:7-8 applies to reproof — some true words are withheld, and withholding is not cowardice.
entries.review: PR17 removed on audit. PR17 is protecting someone from public embarrassment by absorbing the inconvenience oneself. This passage concerns withholding what is valuable from those who will trample it, which is a different act. The tag was assigned from the practice's name — the fourth instance of that error, and the one that exposed three more.

entries.pericope: Ask, seek, knock
entries.connection: Three verbs of increasing insistence, answered by an argument from ordinary fatherhood. Persistence in asking treated as normal rather than presumptuous, which is the posture the Daily Anchors assume.

entries.pericope: Whatever you desire that men do to you
entries.connection: The whole law compressed into one reversible test, stated positively rather than as a prohibition. The Didache opens with its negative form; this is the version that requires action rather than restraint.

entries.pericope: The narrow gate
entries.connection: The Two Ways in the form C01 takes its architecture from, and the same figure the Didache opens with. The narrow way is described as hard to find rather than hard to walk, which locates the difficulty in perception.

entries.pericope: By their fruits you will know them
entries.connection: The test C08 is built on, given as the only reliable instrument against a teacher whose appearance is deliberately reassuring. Sheep's clothing means the disguise is competent, so nothing but outcome will serve.

entries.pericope: Not everyone who says Lord, Lord
entries.connection: Prophecy, exorcism, and mighty works are all conceded and all found insufficient. The proof test of C12 pushed to its hardest form — impressive fruit is not the same as doing the will, and the passage refuses to soften that.

entries.pericope: The house on rock and the house on sand
entries.connection: Both men hear; only one does. The storm is identical for both, which removes circumstance as the variable and leaves only whether the words were acted on — the Moral Audit's premise, and the reason the Sermon ends here rather than on a promise.

entries.pericope: I want to. Be made clean
entries.connection: The leper's doubt is about willingness rather than power, and the answer touches him before it speaks. The one gesture forbidden by the purity code is the one performed first.

entries.pericope: The Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head
entries.connection: A volunteer is warned about homelessness and a disciple asking for a delay is refused it. Neither request is called wrong; both are answered by naming what following actually costs.

entries.pericope: I desire mercy, and not sacrifice
entries.connection: Matthew is called from the tax booth and immediately hosts a table of his former colleagues. The objection is answered with Hosea, and the instruction given to the objectors is to go and learn what the sentence means — mercy set explicitly above religious observance.

entries.pericope: He was moved with compassion, because they were harassed and scattered
entries.connection: The crowd is described as sheep without a shepherd, and the diagnosis is exhaustion rather than wickedness. Compassion given a cause the text names precisely, and the response is a request for more workers rather than a rebuke.

entries.pericope: Freely you received, freely give
entries.connection: Sent without gold, bag, spare coat, or staff, and told to stay in one household rather than move to a better one. The instruction binds host and guest alike — arrivals who own nothing, and workers forbidden to shop for lodging.

entries.pericope: Wise as serpents and harmless as doves
entries.connection: Shrewdness and harmlessness required together, and the persecution described comes through councils, synagogues, and families rather than from strangers. The Citizen-Stranger's difficulty located inside the institutions the person belongs to.

entries.pericope: A cup of cold water to one of these little ones
entries.connection: The discourse on persecution and division ends on the smallest possible act of hospitality, with a reward attached to it. The Sacrament of the Ordinary placed deliberately at the close of the hardest chapter.

entries.pericope: Woe to you, Chorazin
entries.connection: The cities that saw the most are judged more severely than the cities that saw nothing, and Sodom is named as the comparison. Exposure treated as a burden rather than an advantage.

entries.pericope: My yoke is easy, and my burden is light
entries.connection: Rest offered to the labouring and burdened, and then a yoke handed to them — the relief is a change of what is carried rather than the removal of all load. The reason given is his own character: gentle and lowly in heart.

entries.pericope: I desire mercy, and not sacrifice
entries.connection: Hosea quoted a second time, now over hungry disciples and a withered hand. The argument runs from the sheep pulled out of a pit — the rule already bends for property, and the question is whether it bends for a person.

entries.pericope: He won't break a bruised reed
entries.connection: Isaiah cited to describe a method: no striving, no shouting, no voice raised in the streets, and nothing already damaged finished off. The gentlest description of the work anywhere in the Gospels, and it is given as a fulfilment rather than an aspiration.

entries.pericope: Out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks
entries.connection: The fruit test applied to speech and then traced back to its source, with idle words named as the thing accounted for. Watchfulness required at the mouth because the mouth is reporting on the heart.

entries.pericope: The seed among thorns: the cares of this age
entries.connection: Four soils and one seed, with the failure in the third case being neither rejection nor shallowness but slow strangulation by ordinary anxieties and the deceit of riches. Fruit borne over time is the only distinguishing mark.

entries.pericope: Let both grow together until the harvest
entries.connection: The servants propose weeding and are refused, on the grounds that pulling the darnel would uproot the wheat with it. Premature separation forbidden because the sorting cannot yet be done without damage.

entries.pericope: He sold all that he had and bought that field
entries.connection: Two men liquidate everything, and both do it with joy rather than reluctance. Holy Detachment shown as the arithmetic of someone who has found something worth more, which is a different motive from renunciation.

entries.pericope: Isn't this the carpenter's son?
entries.connection: Familiarity presented as the specific obstacle — they can list his mother, his brothers, his sisters, and his trade, and the accuracy of the inventory is what blocks them. Sight prevented by information rather than by its absence.

entries.pericope: His disciples came, took the body, and buried it
entries.connection: John is executed to satisfy an oath made at a party, his disciples bury him and bring word, and the response recorded is withdrawal to a deserted place. Grief given somewhere to go before anything else is asked of him.

entries.pericope: Immediately he stretched out his hand and took hold of him
entries.connection: Peter asks to come, walks, sees the wind, and sinks — and the rescue is immediate, before the question about doubt is asked. The order matters: he is pulled out first and examined afterward.

entries.pericope: What proceeds out of the mouth comes out of the heart
entries.connection: A dispute about handwashing is answered by relocating defilement to its source, and then the list is given plainly — evil thoughts first, and the acts after them. Interior Diagnosis stated as the order in which things actually occur.

entries.pericope: Even the dogs eat the crumbs
entries.connection: She is met with silence, then a refusal, then a hard saying, and she takes the terms she is given and argues inside them rather than against them. Persistence conducted without indignation, from entirely outside the boundary.

entries.pericope: Flesh and blood has not revealed this to you
entries.connection: The right answer is given and immediately credited to someone other than the man who gave it. Perception treated as received rather than achieved, at the moment it would be most natural to congratulate the perceiver.

entries.pericope: Get behind me, Satan
entries.connection: The same man is called blessed and then a stumbling block within six verses, for a rebuke made out of affection. Opposition arriving through someone close and well-meaning, which is the case watchfulness is least prepared for.

entries.pericope: Because of your unbelief
entries.connection: The disciples fail publicly and ask privately why. The answer names their unbelief and then adds that this kind requires prayer and fasting — a deficiency in the ordinary disciplines rather than in technique.

entries.pericope: Lest we cause them to stumble
entries.connection: He establishes that the children are exempt and then pays anyway, specifically to avoid giving offence. A right conceded rather than asserted, with the reasoning stated so it cannot be mistaken for obligation.

entries.pericope: Unless you turn and become as little children
entries.connection: The question about rank is answered by a child placed in the middle, and greatness is redefined as a direction of travel rather than a position reached. Humbling oneself named as the whole of it.

entries.pericope: He rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine
entries.connection: The shepherd leaves the ninety-nine on the hills and goes searching, and the arithmetic is stated as disproportionate on purpose. Set inside a warning against despising the little ones, which makes the search a duty rather than a sentiment.

entries.pericope: Go, show him his fault between you and him alone
entries.connection: Correction begins privately and widens only on refusal — one witness, then two, then the assembly. Covering Weakness built into the procedure itself: exposure is the last resort rather than the first, and every stage is aimed at gaining the brother rather than at establishing the fault.

entries.pericope: Shouldn't you also have had mercy?
entries.connection: Peter proposes seven times and is answered with seventy-seven, then given a parable where the sums are incommensurable — ten thousand talents against a hundred denarii. The servant is not punished for the debt but for what he did with the release, and the fellow servants who report it are the ones who cannot bear the sight.

review_log.adjudication: Accepted in full, and the flag triggered an audit of every PR17 tag in the index. Four of five failed the same test; three of those four had been marked sound in earlier reviews. Fourth instance of assigning a practice from its name rather than its definition.
Clean pass. Two gap proposals declined; one flagged for the author.
